title: Forever World Plus
description: My personal Vanilla Plus Fabric setup for a long term survival world focused on performance stability and quality of life improvements while keeping the vanilla experience intact
body:
Forever World Plus is the exact Fabric setup I use in my own long-term survival world.

It doesn’t overhaul progression or add heavy content. Instead, it focuses on performance, stability, and small quality-of-life improvements while keeping the vanilla experience intact.

This is simply my personal Forever World modpack, cleaned up and shared publicly for anyone who wants a smooth, optimized Vanilla+ experience.

# Focus

- Strong performance and stability
  
- Practical quality-of-life improvements
  
- Subtle visual refinements
  
- Vanilla-faithful gameplay
  
- Optimization stack
  
- Sodium
  
- Lithium
  

Shader support via Iris.

Recommended RAM

4GB (standard use)

6GB (with shaders)

Version 1.0 — first public release of my personal Forever World setup.

Built for players who value performance, longevity, and a clean vanilla experience.
